data.title: US CENTCOM completes wave of retaliatory strikes against Iran | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Iran will respond to the US' newest wave of strikes with an attack "several times larger," the semi-official Tasnim news outlet reported on Tuesday night, citing a senior Iranian military source.
data.keywords: Iran,United States,Middle East,Donald Trump,Hormuz,IRGC,strait of hormuz,CENTCOM
